categories.main_business_segments: Guobo Electronics primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of active phased array T/R modules and RF integrated circuit products. Their main product lines include active phased array T/R modules, RF modules, RF amplifier chips, and RF control chips, serving applications in radar, mobile communication base stations, terminals, satellite communication, and sensing systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages compound semiconductor core technologies, including GaN (gallium nitride) and GaAs (gallium arsenide) materials, to develop analog integrated circuits. They utilize high-density 3D integration, automated testing platforms, and advanced packaging technologies such as metal-ceramic and plastic encapsulation. The company operates a fabless model for chip design, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to third parties, while maintaining in-house design and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include research institutes, system integrators, and major domestic mobile communication equipment manufacturers. The company serves specialized markets such as active phased array radar systems, mobile communication base stations (4G, 5G, and emerging 6G), satellite communication, commercial aerospace, and emerging low-altitude economy sensing systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province. Its sales and services focus on the domestic market, serving Chinese research institutions and communication equipment manufacturers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guobo Electronics operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on chip design, module and component assembly, and testing. It outsources wafer fabrication and packaging to upstream foundries and downstream sells integrated products and modules to system integrators and equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-frequency, high-density integration technologies, including heterogeneous integration and 3D stacking for active phased array T/R modules. It focuses on advancing GaN-based RF modules for 5G-A and 6G applications, integrating communication and sensing functions in RF chips, and expanding into satellite communication and low-altitude economy sectors. R&D efforts emphasize digital transformation of design platforms, intelligent manufacturing, and expanding product portfolios with improved performance and cost efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products including T/R modules, RF modules, and RF chips. The company mainly uses a direct sales model supplemented by some distribution channels. It also provides R&D services and related technical support, recognizing revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance of products or progress in service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Guobo Electronics is a leading domestic provider of active phased array T/R modules and RF integrated circuits, with core technologies at the domestic leading and international advanced levels. It faces competition from large international companies such as Skyworks, Qorvo, and Sumitomo in the general market, but maintains a strong position in specialized markets with high entry barriers due to product stability and security requirements.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.59 billion, a 27.36% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to reduced sales in T/R modules and RF modules. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 484.65 million, down 20.06%. The company’s total assets were about RMB 7.99 billion, with net assets of RMB 6.19 billion. R&D investment accounted for 12.62% of revenue, reflecting a strategic emphasis on innovation despite revenue decline.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guobo Electronics emphasizes its core technology advantages based on compound semiconductors and a comprehensive product portfolio covering chips, modules, and components. Its products feature high integration, small size, light weight, and superior performance, tailored for critical applications in active phased array radar, mobile communication base stations, and satellite communication. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, digital design transformation, and quality control provide differentiated value in reliability, performance, and cost-effectiveness.
